title: Born to be happy, 500 CFA francs
descriptionPlain: Description Symbol of happiness, new beginnings, and boundless love Warm colors and a charming children’s motif The perfect keepsake for a birth, christening, or first family memories There are moments that stay with us forever – a first breath, a first smile, the gentle touch of a tiny hand. The birth of a child marks the beginning of a story filled with unconditional love and boundless happiness. The Born to Be Happy coin enchants with its delicate design, capturing tenderness and the feeling of a safe beginning. Subtle decorations and soft pastel colors highlight the innocence and joy of life’s first moments, making it a unique talisman of happiness and family warmth.
